canon_labels.deuterocanonical: In Orthodox canons, not in the 66-book KJV canon.
canon_labels.ethiopian-only: In the Ethiopian Orthodox canon, not in the Protestant or Catholic canons in that form.
canon_labels.shared: In both the Ethiopian Orthodox canon and the 66-book KJV canon.

foundation: Ethiopian Orthodox Bible, modern English compilation in the PDF supplied by Anthony, rooted in the Septuagint and Ge'ez tradition. Not an ancient manuscript itself.
kjv_parallel_rule: KJV text is shown only in a separate labeled block, only where the same reference exists in the 66-book KJV canon. Wordings are never merged.
note: Pilot only, four passages, manually checked against the extracted PDF text in this session. Not yet wired into engine.py. Not yet verified against a printed edition. Editorial brackets in Jubilees are retained.

passages.ethiopian_text: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
passages.kjv_text: In the beginning God created the heaven, and the earth.

passages.ethiopian_text: God created man in his own image. In God's image he created him; male and female he created them.
passages.kjv_text: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

passages.ethiopian_text: And it came to pass in the first year of the exodus of the children of Israel out of Egypt, in the third month, on the sixteenth day of the month, [2450 Anno Mundi] that God spake to Moses, saying: 'Come up to Me on the Mount, and I will give thee two tables of stone of the law and of the commandment, which I have written, that thou mayst teach them.'
passages.kjv_note: No KJV parallel. Jubilees is Ethiopian-only in this form.

passages.ethiopian_text: I was small among my brothers, and youngest in my father's house. I tended my father's sheep.
passages.kjv_note: No passage in the 66-book KJV canon. The PDF notes Psalm 151 is recognized as deuterocanonical by the Greek Orthodox and Russian Orthodox Churches.
